name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor for rental property renovations?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of hiring a general contractor for rental property renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor simplifies the renovation process by providing a single point of contact responsible for managing the entire project. This includes coordinating subcontractors, managing timelines, ensuring quality control, and handling permits. It saves you time, reduces stress, and helps ensure the project is completed efficiently, on budget, and to professional standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor manages the entire project, coordinating teams, timelines, quality, and permits, saving you time and stress.
